narration.full_text: Let's look at the functions of Gibberellins. Gibberellins primarily help in the growth of the stem. Next, we have Cytokinin. This hormone promotes cell division within plants. Finally, we discuss Abscisic acid. This hormone has an inhibitory effect, meaning it inhibits growth and can also lead to the wilting of leaves. Now, let's consider a question: Which signals will get disrupted in case of a spinal cord injury? In case of a spinal cord injury, signals for reflex action and involuntary action will get disrupted. This is because reflex actions are monitored and controlled through the spinal cord of the nervous system, not directly by the brain. Nerves from all over the body meet in a bundle in the spinal cord on their way to the brain. Therefore, any injury to the spinal cord will disrupt the signals coming from the nerves as well as signals going to the receptors.
